instruction: A warehouse starts with 1000 boxes. It then increases its stock by 12.5 percent, discarding any fractional box (rounded down). Then it ships exactly one third of the new stock, discarding any fractional box (rounded down). Then it increases the resulting stock by 50 percent, discarding any fractional box (rounded down). How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
